scheme_name: Scheme For Providing Assistive Devices To Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of at least 40%
Medical Board must certify that the applicant is capable of using the assistive device
benefits_summary: Provision of various assistive devices (e.g., joystick‑operated wheelchair, smart phone with screen reader, Daisy player, CP wheelchair, talking calculator) to eligible persons with disabilities.
